//: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the site is PRE-BUILT into site/dist and committed (see .gitignore and
docs/site-dist.md). With no config, Vercel infers project type 'Other' and serves the
REPOSITORY ROOT, so every top-level URL 404s -- the site sits two directories down, reachable
only at /site/dist/... Setting outputDirectory makes site/dist the root and fixes that.
A static site needs no build: there is no package.json here (this is a Python repo), so any
framework preset or install step would fail. buildCommand and installCommand are null, and
framework is null so Vercel cannot apply a preset.
DELIBERATELY NOT SET: cleanUrls / trailingSlash. Every page links its neighbours with explicit
turn all of those into 308 redirects for no gain, so the URL shape is left exactly as built.
